# Sur - International Journal on Human Rights

> > Sur is a biannual open-access human rights journal published by Conectas that centers Global South perspectives on democracy, activism, and social justice.

Sur is a leading international publication on human rights with editorial focus on decolonial approaches, civil resistance, and voices from the Global South. The journal publishes peer-reviewed articles, essays, and visual content in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.

## Key Topics

- human rights
- Global South
- democracy
- activism
- social movements

## Core Resources

- [Sur Homepage](https://sur.conectas.org): Main homepage for Sur, biannual human rights journal by Conectas
- [About Sur](https://sur.conectas.org/sobre): Journal history, editorial policy, and mission centered on Global South perspectives
- [English Edition](https://sur.conectas.org/en): English language homepage for Sur international human rights journal
- [Spanish Edition](https://sur.conectas.org/es): Spanish language homepage for Sur international human rights journal

## Journal Archives & Issues

- [All Editions](https://sur.conectas.org/edicoes): Complete archive of all Sur journal editions and publication history
- [Issue #33](https://sur.conectas.org/home/edicao-33): Current journal edition with articles and essays
- [Articles Archive](https://sur.conectas.org/cat/artigos): Archive of peer-reviewed articles on human rights, democracy, and activism
- [Essays Archive](https://sur.conectas.org/cat/ensaios): Archive of essays on human rights, democracy, and social justice
- [Visual Content Archive](https://sur.conectas.org/cat/imagens): Visual content archive of activism imagery and cultural memory

## Featured Content

- [Sur 33 Editorial Letter](https://sur.conectas.org/sur-33-carta-as-pessoas-leitoras): Editorial letter for Sur Issue 33 on authoritarianism and human rights
- [The Re-enchantment of Human Rights](https://sur.conectas.org/o-reencantamento-dos-direitos-humanos): Essay by Sueli Carneiro on racial justice and Black feminism activism
- [The Palestine Question](https://sur.conectas.org/a-questao-da-palestina): Article on Palestine question and decolonial human rights approach
- [Social Media and Far-Right Extremism in South Africa](https://sur.conectas.org/o-impacto-das-midias-sociais-e-o-crescimento-do-radicalismo-da-extrema-direita-na-africa-do-sul): Article on social media impact on far-right extremism in South Africa
- [Brazilian Democracy: Resistance and Reconstruction Post-Bolsonaro](https://sur.conectas.org/a-democracia-por-um-fio-resistencia-e-reconstrucao-no-brasil-pos-bolsonaro): Analysis of Brazilian democracy, authoritarianism, and civil resistance
- [Interview: Egyptian Human Rights Activism](https://sur.conectas.org/e-preciso-recusar-questionar-e-resistir-a-este-estado-de-sobrevivencia-psicologico): Interview with Hossam Bahgat on Egyptian human rights activism and psychological survival
